sections.Profile:
Sea Hunt, released by Allied Leisure Industries Inc. in 1972, is a unique electro-mechanical pinball machine featuring a horizontal playfield viewed through a large mirror, creating an immersive underwater diving theme.

- Manufacturer: Allied Leisure Industries Inc.
- Years made: 1972
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Swimming, Scuba Diving, 1970s, Weird Pinball Machines, Water
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Roland Berrios
- Design: Ron Halliburton
